title: Balance setup and hold margins
caption: Change clock period and signed capture skew to compare the latest-data setup limit with the earliest-data hold limit.
accessibleSummary: Labeled bars share a picosecond timeline for data arrival, the same-cycle hold window and the next-cycle setup window. Keyboard-operable clock-period and signed-skew sliders update setup and hold slack, distinguishing violations and zero-margin boundaries.
